title: Lever Jobs Search output
description: The jobs found, one row per job in the default dataset (switch between the Jobs and Details views), plus a run summary record.

jobs.title: Jobs found (jobs)
jobs.description: Every saved job, newest first: title, company, locations, work type, job type, department, team, pay, posting date and job link, and with details on the description, pay as numbers with its period and country. Export as JSON, CSV or Excel.

summary.title: Run summary (summary)
summary.description: The OUTPUT record in the default key-value store: job sites read, job sites and companies with a match, jobs matched and saved, checked links, job sites that could not be read, notes about how the input was read, and the settings used.
